name: PatchMatch-based Multi-view Stereo (PM-MVS)
definition: A method that represents geometric with depth and/or normal maps, estimating depth and normal of each pixel by exploiting inter-image photometric and geometric consistency, then fusing depth maps into a global point cloud.
summary: PM-MVS is a traditional multi-view stereo method that estimates depth and normals via explicit probabilistic optimization and PatchMatch correspondence, distinguishing itself from learned feature matching approaches.
